4.3. As of the date hereof, no event, development, circumstance, or condition has occurred or arisen that, individually or in the aggregate, has had or would reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the Fund, the GP, the ManCo, or any portfolio company of the Fund, or that would reasonably be expected to impair the GP\'s ability to perform its obligations under the LPA or the Restructuring Documents.

4.4. The Fund\'s term expires on December 31, 2029, subject to two (2) one-year extensions at the discretion of the GP, in each case in accordance with Section 2.4 of the LPA. The Fund\'s investment period ends on June 30, 2025. The GP confirms that the Restructuring does not affect or alter the Fund\'s term or the investment period, and that the GP intends to continue actively managing the Fund and its portfolio companies through the expiration of the Fund\'s term (as may be extended).

**[SECTION 5: CONDITIONS TO CLOSING SATISFIED]{.underline}**

5.1. The undersigned hereby certifies, on behalf of the GP, that all conditions precedent to the closing of the Restructuring as set forth in the Restructuring Documents have been satisfied or, where applicable, waived as of the date hereof, including without limitation the following:

> \(a\) **Execution and Delivery of Restructuring Documents.** All Restructuring Documents have been duly executed and delivered by all parties thereto, and fully executed counterparts of each Restructuring Document have been delivered to Calderwood & Harkness LLP, as restructuring counsel, and to Pemberton Hale LLP, as fund formation counsel.
>
> \(b\) **Formation Filings.** Certificates of Formation for Ardent Capital Holdings LLC (Delaware Secretary of State File No. 7948231) and Ardent GP Intermediate LLC (Delaware Secretary of State File No. 7948237) have been prepared and are expected to be filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware on or about March 1, 2024. Pemberton Hale LLP has been authorized to effect such filings on behalf of the GP and the principals. The GP confirms that such filings are ministerial in nature and that the entities will be duly formed upon the acceptance of such filings by the Delaware Secretary of State.
>
> \(c\) **LPAC Consent.** The consent of the LPAC has been duly obtained pursuant to Section 9.4 of the LPA at the virtual meeting of the LPAC held on February 14, 2024, as more fully described in Section 3.1(a) of this Certificate.
>
> \(d\) **Side-Letter Compliance Review.** The comprehensive side-letter compliance review has been completed, and a memorandum summarizing the results thereof was finalized by Pemberton Hale LLP on February 22, 2024, as more fully described in Section 3.1(c) of this Certificate. All required notifications have been sent and all required consents have been obtained.
>
> \(e\) **No Key Person Event.** Neither David Kellner nor Joanna Trask is a designated \"Key Person\" under Section 5.2 of the LPA. The designated Key Persons under Section 5.2 of the LPA are Marcus Aldridge and Priya Narayanan. The undersigned confirms that, as of the date hereof, no Key Person Event (as defined in Section 5.2 of the LPA) has been triggered or is reasonably expected to be triggered in connection with the Restructuring or otherwise. Each of Marcus Aldridge and Priya Narayanan continues to devote substantially all of his or her business time and attention to the affairs of the Fund and the ManCo, as required under Section 5.2 of the LPA, and each has confirmed his or her intention to continue to do so following the closing of the Restructuring.
>
> \(f\) **Separation Agreements.** The Separation and Release Agreement with David Kellner has been duly executed and delivered by all parties thereto, providing for Mr. Kellner\'s retirement from the GP and the ManCo effective as of March 31, 2024. The Separation and Release Agreement with Joanna Trask has been duly executed and delivered by all parties thereto, providing for Ms. Trask\'s departure from the GP and the ManCo effective as of April 15, 2024. Each such Separation and Release Agreement contains a full and unconditional release of claims by the departing principal in favor of the GP, the ManCo, the Fund, HoldCo, GP Intermediate, and each of the remaining principals, and provides for customary non-competition, non-solicitation, and confidentiality covenants. The Carry Retention and Clawback Side Letters for each of Mr. Kellner and Ms. Trask have been duly executed and delivered, setting forth the terms of their respective retained carried interest entitlements, vesting schedules, and clawback obligations.
>
> \(g\) **GP Commitment Reallocation.** The parties have agreed upon the reallocation of the combined \$3,402,000 in unfunded GP commitment attributable to the departing principals (David Kellner: \$1,890,000; Joanna Trask: \$1,512,000) among the remaining members of HoldCo on a pro rata basis as follows:

{"file_path":"response.md","content":"# Funds & Asset Management matters with an LP advisory committee

## Answer

**2 matters** qualify.

| Matter | Fund | Why it qualifies | LPA status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1001-00002** | **Ardent Capital Partners III LP (Fund III)** | The matter is a private-funds restructuring engagement covering the Fund's management-company restructuring, LPAC consent, side-letter compliance, and LPA amendment. The Fund had an LPAC consisting of Ridgeline Public Employees' Retirement System, Crestwood Endowment Partners, Pinnacle Insurance Group, and Graystone Family Office LLC. | **Signed/executed.** The file documents an existing signed LPA dated April 15, 2019, and an executed Amendment No. 1 effective February 28, 2024. |
| **1003-00002** | **Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP (HPE Fund V)** | The matter is explicitly a Funds & Asset Management/private-equity fund-formation engagement. The Fund's LPA contains an LPAC article, and the separate LPAC Charter establishes the committee and identifies its initial members. | **Signed/executed at the First Close.** Although the retained LPA file is named “revised draft,” the First Close legal opinion confirms that the LPA was dated August 15, 2025, duly executed and delivered by the GP and First Close LPs, and enforceable. |

## Matters and documents relied on

### 1. Matter 1001-00002 — Ardent Capital Partners III LP

**Matter classification and scope**

- `documents/matters/1001-00002/Engagement & Administration/engagement-letter.docx` — the October 9, 2023 engagement letter describes a comprehensive restructuring of the management company and realignment of economics for Ardent Capital Partners III LP, including solicitation of LPAC consent under Section 9.4 of the LPA and side-letter compliance.
- `documents/matters/1001-00002/Engagement & Administration/conflict-check-memo.docx` — identifies the engagement as a Private Funds matter and describes the Fund, its LPAC members, and the LPAC-consent workstream.

**LPAC evidence**

- `documents/matters/1001-00002/LP Consent & Notification/lpac-notification-and-consent-letter.docx` — dated February 5, 2024; addressed to the four LPAC members and expressly solicits LPAC consent under Section 9.4 of the LPA. It identifies the Fund as Ardent Capital Partners III LP and lists Ridgeline Public Employees' Retirement System, Crestwood Endowment Partners, Pinnacle Insurance Group, and Graystone Family Office LLC as LPAC members.
- `documents/matters/1001-00002/LP Consent & Notification/lpac-presentation-memo.docx` — describes the Fund's LPAC, its governance role, and the restructuring presented for LPAC approval.
- `documents/matters/1001-00002/LP Consent & Notification/lpac-form-of-written-consent.docx` — effective February 14, 2024; states that the LPAC was duly constituted under the LPA and consents to the restructuring, including the LPA amendment. The form provides signature blocks for all four LPAC members.

**Signed-LPA evidence**

- `documents/matters/1001-00002/Amended Governing Documents/lpa-amendment-no-1.docx` — Amendment No. 1 to the Fund's LPA. Its recitals refer to the existing Partnership Agreement and state that the LPAC provided written consent at its February 14, 2024 meeting. Its signature section states that it was executed by Ardent Capital GP III LLC on February 28, 2024 and acknowledges the LPAC Written Consent.
- `documents/matters/1001-00002/Closing/closing-certificate-gp.docx` — dated February 28, 2024; expressly references the Fund's LPA and Amendment No. 1, confirms that the LPAC consent was obtained, and certifies that all restructuring documents were duly executed and delivered.
- `documents/matters/1001-00002/Engagement & Administration/matter-closing-memo.docx` — states that Amendment No. 1 to the Fund's LPA was executed as of February 28, 2024 following receipt of LPAC consent, and lists the LPAC notification, presentation memorandum, and executed LPAC written consent among the completed closing deliverables.

**Reasoning**
